newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet soars with NYMEX, but Gulf diffs sag.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet soars with NYMEX, but Gulf diffs sag.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices soared as a 1.88 cent gain in April NYMEX futures handily offset a 1.15 cent weakening in differentials for Gulf Coast fuel, traders said.

Gulf aviation-quality 54-grade fuel was sold for 0.75 cent and 0.85 cent over the April print, traders said, adding diffs slid in reaction to the strong NYMEX gain and because of a dearth of buyers on today's scheduling deadline for front-ninth-cycle material.
"With the deadline here and not much demand, sellers had to drink it," one Gulf player said, adding low-sulfur 55-grade was fetching no premium to 54-grade.
New York 54-grade, meanwhile, held steady at 4.0 cents over the April print, players said.
